display.purpose: Hero headlines only. One per page maximum.

body.purpose: Running text. Cap line length at 65ch.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions. 200ms duration.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button. Steel Blue background, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #ffffff; background: #5599d4; border: none; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4889c0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0d0f13, 0 0 0 4px rgba(85, 153, 212, 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button. Transparent with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #eef0f3; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #25282e; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(238, 240, 243, 0.05); border-color: rgba(238, 240, 243, 0.2); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0d0f13, 0 0 0 4px rgba(85, 153, 212, 0.5); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Minimal button for tertiary actions. No background, muted text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgba(238, 240, 243, 0.7); background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 0.625rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #eef0f3; background: rgba(238, 240, 243, 0.05); }

components.name: Default Card
components.description: Standard container card. One tonal step above body background.
components.html:
Titlu Card

Descriere scurtă a conținutului cardului.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #121519; border: 1px solid #25282e; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1.5rem; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(37, 40, 46, 0.8); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #eef0f3; margin: 0 0 0.375rem 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.55; color: #858a93; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input. Understated at rest, steel blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #eef0f3; background: #0d0f13; border: 1px solid #25282e; border-radius: 0.625rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(133, 138, 147, 0.6); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(37, 40, 46, 0.8); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(85, 153, 212, 0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(85, 153, 212, 0.2); }

components.description: Floating glass header bar pinned to top of viewport.

narrative.overview:
WebForm's design system speaks with the confidence of someone who knows exactly what they're doing and doesn't need to prove it. Like a well-tailored suit, the premium quality comes from restraint and precision — the cut of the typography, the rhythm of the spacing, the deliberate absence of decoration. Every element earns its place; nothing is ornamental.

The system explicitly rejects three patterns: the generic SaaS aesthetic (radial gradients, glass cards, purple-to-blue color stories), the cheap website builder look (template-preview dashboards, drag-and-drop metaphors), and over-designed agency sites (parallax everything, navigation buried under effects).
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, with depth conveyed through tonal layering rather than shadows
Typography-driven hierarchy using Space Grotesk for authority and Inter for readability
Generous whitespace as a signal of confidence, not emptiness
Steel blue as the sole accent color — used sparingly, never decoratively
Motion that reveals content naturally, never gates it

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Steel Blue is reserved for interactive elements. If an element isn't clickable, it isn't blue.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: No box-shadows on cards, containers, or buttons. Depth comes from tonal layering.

rules.name: The Font-Display Boundary Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk is used exclusively at heading-sm and above. Body text always uses Inter.

dos: Do use Steel Blue exclusively for interactive elements
Do maintain the tonal layering sequence: body → card → muted
Do cap body text line length at 65ch
Do use Space Grotesk for all headings heading-sm and above
Do use text-wrap: balance on h1-h3 elements
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every animation
Do use the CSS variable system for all colors
donts: Don't use radial gradients, glass cards, or glowing orb effects for decoration
Don't make it look like a website builder
Don't bury navigation under effects or animations
Don't use box-shadows on cards or buttons
Don't add eyebrow kickers above every section heading
Don't use numbered section markers as default decoration
Don't hardcode colors outside the CSS variable system
